title: DCAT 3 and STAC 1.1 semantic metadata round trip

source.description: Deterministic public metadata documents exercising canonical source preservation, explicit conversion reporting, and semantic export without network access.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: Both standards imports preserve their exact canonical JSON as immutable revision evidence and enumerate every unmapped top-level field.
DCAT 3 and STAC 1.1 exports retain the fixture's title, description, rights, keywords, spatial bbox, and temporal interval semantics.
Language-tagged English/French DCAT values survive two-way mapping, and the OGC Records 1.0 projection negotiates one language while advertising its alternate without claiming unverified conformance.
DCAT publisher metadata maps into the bounded native OpenGeo contact model and re-exports as a standards-shaped agent.
